messages:
Mira: 🎉 We officially crossed 120M ARR!! thank you everyone — feels surreal. rooftop tonight at 6 to celebrate? tacos, mariachi, and tiny pin giveaways? :tada: :mexico:

Alex: I'M IN. will bring the speaker and some LED lights. can we get vegan taco options too? :headphones: :seedling:

Sam: congrats team!! that deploy was smooth AF. felt like a magic trick. :sparkles:

Joel: bringing a sombrero. optional but strongly encouraged. 😎

Taylor: quick poll — react with your food choice: :taco: tacos, :pizza: pizza, or :fish_cake: sushi. poll ends in 10m!

Ops-bot: Rooftop reservation confirmed for 6–8pm. Capacity: 40. Event name: "120M Rooftop Toast" (automated)

Mira: poll started — 10 minutes to vote! will order based on reactions. also, pins are a go. mini cactus pins? 🌵

Alex: +1 cactus pins. also can we get a mocktail option for non-drinkers?

Anya: huge shoutout to infra and SRE — zero incidents on rollout. you folks are the real MVPs. :clap: :heart:

Sam: meme time: "me at 2am patching a bug -> waking up to 120M" [link] :joy:

Mira: current reaction tally — :taco: 8, :pizza: 2, :fish_cake: 1. tacos win. ordering underway. :taco:

Alex: i'll coordinate orders with the vendor. anyone who can help pack swag into bags at 5:15? need 4 volunteers.

Joel: i'll help pack. and I'll rock the sombrero for morale. :drum:

Anya: i'll be there to hand out stickers and pins. congrats again team ❤️

Mira: tiny reminder — if you can't make it but want a pin, drop an emoji and we'll hold one for you. otherwise see you at 6 for confetti and tiny mariachi. :confetti_ball:
